description: Elias Manos publishes a spatial workflow for deriving building heights across Arctic communities. Zenodo archives a versioned repository under CC BY 4.0. The GitHub README says scripts sample ArcticDEM digital-surface elevations within building footprints and compare them with surrounding terrain to estimate height and number of storeys. These derived attributes can improve building-stock exposure in permafrost damage or retrofit simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this height-extraction workflow; a separately archived Arctic building inventory is an output, not the code itself. Coverage depends on ArcticDEM mosaic quality and footprint completeness across circumpolar settlements. A limitation is that digital-surface models include roof forms and local terrain effects, and the page does not provide a universal height-error bound. ArcticDEM and footprint source terms must be checked separately. The archive and imagery were not downloaded, and no height estimate was independently measured or recalculated.
